bar_color.label: Bar colour
bar_color.description: Theme colour role used for the classic filled track and circular knob.

slider_width.label: Slider width (px)
slider_width.description: Expanded track width in pixels, independent of thickness and speaker size.

scroll_step.label: Scroll step (%)
scroll_step.description: How much one scroll notch changes the volume.

invert_scroll.label: Invert scroll direction
invert_scroll.description: By default scroll up raises the volume. Turn this on if it feels backwards.

show_percent.label: Show percentage
show_percent.description: Show volume percentage or muted. Click this label to open Audio.

icon_click.label: Speaker click
icon_click.description: Click the speaker to toggle mute, or open Audio. Click the expanded track to set volume. Percentage/padding and right-click open Audio.

slider_thickness.label: Slider thickness (px)
slider_thickness.description: Track thickness, independent of its width. The circular knob is 1.5 times this size.

drag_enabled.label: Enable dragging
drag_enabled.description: Drag the classic volume track. It folds when idle and stays open during an active drag.

show_knob.label: Show handle
show_knob.description: Show the circle or flat handle at the current volume. Turn off for a plain bar.

knob_color.label: Handle colour
knob_color.description: Independent knob colour. On-primary matches the knob used by native Settings sliders.

point_style.label: Point style
point_style.description: Rounded or flat moving progress edge. Flat also uses a slim rectangular volume handle.

gauge.label: Show gauge bar
gauge.description: Compact display: gauge bar (on) or plain percentage (off)

show_gpu.label: Show GPU usage
show_gpu.description: Show GPU utilisation beside CPU usage using Noctalia system monitoring. A dash means the sensor is unavailable or still loading.

gauge.label: Show gauge bar
gauge.description: Compact display: gauge bar (on) or plain percentage (off)

amount_first.label: Show used amount by default
amount_first.description: On: shows used GB by default, revealing the percentage and total on hover. Off: shows the percentage by default, revealing used/total GB on hover.

show_nvme.label: Show hottest NVMe temp on hover

show_hottest_core.label: Show hottest CPU core on hover

threshold_kbps.label: Idle threshold (KB/s)
threshold_kbps.description: Hide entirely below this; hovering always shows it. 1024 = 1 MB/s

hide_completely.label: Hide widget entirely when idle
hide_completely.description: On: vanishes below the idle threshold. Off: icon stays, only the number hides

threshold_kbps.label: Idle threshold (KB/s)
threshold_kbps.description: Hide entirely below this; hovering always shows it. 1024 = 1 MB/s

hide_completely.label: Hide widget entirely when idle
hide_completely.description: On: vanishes below the idle threshold. Off: icon stays, only the number hides

show_cover_art.label: Show cover art
show_cover_art.description: Replace the play/pause icon with the track's (rounded) cover art when available.

show_progress_bar.label: Show progress bar
show_progress_bar.description: Show a playback-position bar next to the icon. It's a rendered image (not text), so it never affects the widget's Font setting -- when cover art is on, the bar sits beside the art; when off, it replaces the play/pause glyph.

compact_width.label: Compact width (characters)
compact_width.description: Text width when not hovering. The text only actually shrinks to this if it's longer -- a short title just stays put.

expand_width.label: Expanded width (characters)
expand_width.description: Maximum title characters on hover. Shorter titles use only the space they need; longer titles cycle within the limit.

cover_size.label: Cover art size (px)
cover_size.description: Size of the cover art icon in place of the play/pause glyph.

progress_width.label: Compact progress width (px)
progress_width.description: Width of the seek slider in this state. Expanded width is at least the compact width. Set both equal for a fixed length.

progress_expand_width.label: Expanded progress width (px)
progress_expand_width.description: Width of the seek slider in this state. Expanded width is at least the compact width. Set both equal for a fixed length.

progress_style.label: Progress style
progress_style.description: Classic supports clicks. Classic with dragging keeps the same pill, uses expanded width, previews while dragging and seeks on release. Interactive uses the native slider appearance.

progress_thickness.label: Progress thickness (px)
progress_thickness.description: Progress bar thickness, independent of cover size and width. Rounded ends stay circular.

point_style.label: Point style
point_style.description: Rounded or flat moving progress edge. Applies to classic and background progress; the native slider keeps its own style.

show_controls.label: Playback controls
show_controls.description: Show previous, play/pause and next buttons.

progress_layout.label: Progress placement
progress_layout.description: Inline seekable bar or progress behind the media content. Click the background title/progress area to seek; artwork and buttons retain playback actions.

background_width.label: Background width
background_width.description: Compact background pill width, in pixels; it grows to Expanded background width on hover.

background_height.label: Background thickness
background_height.description: Thickness of the background progress pill, in pixels.

controls_on_hover.label: Controls only on hover
controls_on_hover.description: When Playback controls is enabled, animate those buttons in and out on hover.

background_expand_width.label: Expanded background width
background_expand_width.description: Maximum hovered background width. Expansion stops earlier when the whole title fits; longer titles cycle within this limit.

bar_color.label: Progress colour
bar_color.description: Pick a theme colour or a custom colour for classic progress.

scroll_action.label: Scroll action
scroll_action.description: Skip tracks or seek through the current song with the mouse wheel.

scroll_seek_step.label: Scroll seek seconds
scroll_seek_step.description: Seconds per wheel step. Scroll up goes forward; down goes back.

background_seek_strip.label: Right-click controls to seek
background_seek_strip.description: Right-click a playback button to seek at its position on the background progress. Left-click operates the button; right-click elsewhere opens Media controls.

background_progress_color.label: Progress colour
background_progress_color.description: Pick a theme colour or a custom colour for the background progress fill.

background_darkening.label: Background darkening (%)
background_darkening.description: Darken the unplayed background around the progress. Zero matches the widget background; the progress colour stays at full strength.

progress_darkening.label: Progress darkening (%)
progress_darkening.description: Darken the played progress fill itself, from 0% (original colour) to 80%. Applies to background and classic progress.

audio_spectrum.label: Audio visualiser
audio_spectrum.description: Show live audio bars behind background progress, or beside the controls for inline progress. Uses the shell’s shared audio spectrum; rests when paused or silent.

visualiser_color.label: Visualiser colour
visualiser_color.description: Theme/custom audio-bar colour. In inverted mode this is the lighter background colour; progress mode uses Progress colour.

visualiser_opacity.label: Visualiser opacity (%)
visualiser_opacity.description: Opacity of the audio visualiser, independent of progress colour and darkening.

visualiser_height.label: Visualiser height (px)
visualiser_height.description: Maximum height of the centred audio bars.

visualiser_width.label: Inline visualiser width (px)
visualiser_width.description: Width when progress is inline; background mode uses the media widget’s full width.

audio_spectrum_bands.label: Visualiser bands
audio_spectrum_bands.description: Number of live frequency bands, from 8 to 128. Bars and gaps adapt to fit the widget.

visualiser_mode.label: Visualiser masking
visualiser_mode.description: Background layout: overlay, show only on played progress, dark on progress/light on background, or use the audio bars as the progress fill. Inline visualisers keep the overlay style.

options.inverted: Dark on progress / light on background

compact_width.label: Compact width (characters)
compact_width.description: Text width when not hovering. The title only actually shrinks to this if it's longer -- a short title just stays put.

expand_width.label: Expanded width (characters)
expand_width.description: Text width while hovering. If the title is still longer than this, it scrolls as a marquee instead of growing further.

icon_size.label: Icon size (px)
icon_size.description: Per-app icon size when compact (not hovering). Only affects the real app icon -- the generic fallback glyph (shown when no icon can be resolved) is a fixed size, since the plugin API doesn't expose glyph sizing.

icon_size_hover.label: Icon size on hover (px)
icon_size_hover.description: Per-app icon size while hovering; animates between this and the compact size along with the text width.
